FAQ

How do I submit a document for processing?

Download our app, select the service you need, and follow the prompts to submit your documents.

What security measures do you have in place?

: We use SSL encryption, OAuth 2.0, and AES encryption to ensure your data and documents are secure.

How long does it take to process a document?

Processing times vary depending on the service, but we strive to complete most requests within a few business days.

Can I cancel my document processing?

Yes! Send us a message and we’ll process your request no questions asked.

Do you provide additional support?

Chat and email support is available 24/7. Phone lines are open during normal business hours.
